Life Insurance Guide

Understanding life insurance shouldn't require reading fine print with a magnifying glass. Here is your roadmap to choosing the right cover for every stage of life.

Choose a Category to Explore

🛡️

Term Assurance

Pure Protection • Maximum Coverage

High life coverage at the lowest possible cost. Ensures your family's income replacement, loan payoff, and children's future if you're no longer around.

🏦

Endowment & Savings

Protection + Guaranteed Savings

Traditional policies (like LIC Jeevan Utsav & Labh) combining insurance cover with low-risk guaranteed returns and maturity bonuses.

Explore Savings Plans →
📈

ULIPs & Market Plans

Investment + Protection

Unit Linked Insurance Plans that invest a portion of your premium into equity or debt funds to generate long-term wealth along with cover.

Explore ULIP Plans →

💡 How Much Coverage Do You Really Need?

A simple rule of thumb for term insurance is 10x to 15x your annual income, plus any existing debts (home loan, personal loan). Never treat life insurance purely as an investment—mix pure protection for security with dedicated investment instruments for wealth.
